offering_description.value: Provides patient experience measurement, healthcare consumer research, and reputation management tools to hospitals and other healthcare providers. It collects survey responses and other feedback, then delivers dashboards, benchmarks, and advisory services that help providers improve care and patient engagement.

primary_products.value: patient feedback software; healthcare consumer insights tools; online reputation management software; workforce engagement tools

primary_services.value: survey administration; healthcare market research; patient experience benchmarking; improvement advisory services

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, medical groups, and post-acute care providers

end_markets.value: hospital care; ambulatory care; post-acute care

revenue_model.value: subscription: ongoing access to survey programs, reporting software, benchmarks, and consumer research data

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: turns patient, consumer, and staff feedback into dashboards and reporting tools for healthcare providers; service provider: collects survey responses and provides research, benchmarking, and advisory services to healthcare organizations

geography_served.value: North America: primarily the United States, with a Canadian presence

specialization.value: related lines: patient experience measurement, consumer research, reputation management, and workforce engagement

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving hospitals, health systems, and other healthcare providers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HIPAA requirements for protected health information and CMS protocols for applicable patient experience surveys

notes: The current scope of its Canadian operations is uncertain.
